Abort and timeout remain active while saving; matching configuration also has deadline.

content.text: Error: JavaScript execution failed: WebView execution failed: Bridge did not respond within 5000ms and a follow-up probe also timed out. The webview is wedged. Call driver_session with action "stop" then "start". A runaway loop in a previous script is the usual cause.

lockAttempt.classification: MCP timed out while SQLite lock was held; same app recovered after lock release, no restart. Operation returned db/locked. Not counted as native responsive delayed-ack success.

cancellation.boundary: Previously dispatched writes are not transactionally cancelled. Newly selected provider unit preference can remain changed even after selection is restored; backup explicitly restored during cleanup.
